defaults.motion_elements: the chandelier sparkle and the tree lights

shots.subject: A grand marble hotel lobby with a very tall Christmas tree in gold and ivory ornaments at its centre, two crystal chandeliers hanging high on either side of it, the tree's star well clear of both, a polished checkerboard floor mirroring the lights and cream columns wrapped in pine garland

A hotel lobby grand staircase of pale stone sweeping up in two curved flights, both balustrades wrapped in pine garland and warm lights, a tall tree standing between the flights and a crystal chandelier hanging in the stairwell
shots.focus: the grand staircase and the tree

shots.subject: A hotel lobby lounge with a carved stone fireplace and a crackling log fire, a garland with gold ribbons on the mantel, deep cream armchairs around a low marble table and a lit tree beside the hearth
shots.motion_elements: the fire, the tree lights and the chandelier sparkle
shots.ambient: The fire flickers in the fireplace. Chandelier crystals sparkle softly.

shots.subject: The brass-and-glass revolving door of an old hotel lobby under a garland arch full of warm lights, two small potted trees on either side, a polished marble floor, and snow falling on a lamplit street outside the glass
shots.motion_elements: the garland lights, the street lamps and the snow falling outside the doors
shots.ambient: Snow falls on the street outside the glass doors. Chandelier crystals sparkle softly.

shots.subject: A wood-panelled hotel lobby bar with a long polished counter, a mirrored back bar of glowing crystal glassware and unlabelled decanters, a garland with gold baubles along the counter edge and a small lit tree at its end
shots.motion_elements: the garland lights, the glowing glassware and the mirror reflections
shots.ambient: The glassware on the back bar glints softly.

shots.subject: A tall glass-roofed hotel atrium hung with dozens of glowing brass star lanterns at different heights, a tall tree ringed by white poinsettias on the floor below and the balconies of the upper floors wrapped in warm lights
shots.motion_elements: the star lanterns, the tree lights and the balcony lights
shots.ambient: The hanging star lanterns glow and sway very slightly.

shots.subject: An Art Deco hotel lobby with a gold-inlaid marble floor, stepped geometric brass chandeliers, black lacquered columns trimmed with garland and a tall tree dressed in white and silver
A high view from a hotel mezzanine balcony looking over its garland-wrapped railing down onto a tall lit tree, the crystal chandelier hanging at eye level and the glossy marble floor far below

A long carved-wood hotel reception desk dressed with a thick garland, gold baubles and a pair of small brass lamps, a brass service bell on the counter, a large wreath on the panelled wall behind and a lit tree to one side
shots.motion_elements: the garland lights, the lamp glow and the tree lights

shots.subject: A marble side table in a hotel lobby with a silver bowl of gold and glass ornaments, a pair of tall lit white candles and a sprig of pine, the tall tree and chandelier glowing as soft bokeh behind
shots.motion_elements: the candle flames and the bokeh of the tree lights

shots.subject: A palm court tea lounge under a stained-glass skylight dome of gold and cream geometric panes, tall potted palms wound with fairy lights, round tables in white linen with small candles and a tall tree in the centre
shots.focus: the tree beneath the glass dome
shots.motion_elements: the candle flames, the fairy lights in the palms and the tree lights
shots.ambient: Small candle flames flicker on the tables.

shots.subject: A hotel lobby seating nook by tall arched windows, cream velvet sofas, a brass floor lamp, a low table with a gingerbread house and snow falling on a lamplit square outside
shots.motion_elements: the lamp glow, the tree lights and the snow outside the windows
shots.ambient: Snow falls outside the tall windows. Chandelier crystals sparkle softly.

shots.subject: A circular domed hotel rotunda with a round marble floor, a tall tree in the exact centre beneath a golden coffered dome, and a ring of cream columns each spiralled with garland and warm lights
A brass luggage trolley piled with wrapped gifts in cream and gold paper and velvet ribbons, standing beside a lit tree on a marble lobby floor, a crystal chandelier glowing above
A crystal chandelier dressed with a ring of pine and small gold baubles, its hundreds of prisms catching warm light, the top of the tall lobby tree softly blurred below
shots.motion_elements: the chandelier prisms and the soft bokeh of the tree lights
shots.ambient: The chandelier prisms sparkle and catch the light.

shots.subject: The stone front of a grand old hotel at night, tall glowing windows on every floor, a deep entrance canopy edged with lights, two tall lit trees in planters flanking wide steps and snow falling on the forecourt
shots.motion_elements: the canopy lights, the lit trees and the falling snow

shots.subject: A glossy white grand piano beside a tall lit tree in a hotel lobby, a garland with warm lights draped along the curve of the piano, a tall vase of white roses and pine on a stand nearby and a chandelier above
A hotel lobby seen from the entrance doors: a wide marble aisle between two rows of small lit trees in gold pots, leading to a very tall tree beneath a crystal chandelier
shots.focus: the tall tree at the end of the aisle

shots.subject: A stone staircase balustrade wrapped in a thick pine garland with gold ribbon bows, pinecones and warm lights, the lobby and its chandelier blurred into bokeh beyond
shots.motion_elements: the garland lights and the chandelier bokeh

shots.subject: The lower branches of the lobby tree hung with glass, gold and pearl ornaments and warm bulbs, wrapped gifts piled beneath, the polished marble floor reflecting every light
shots.motion_elements: the tree lights and their reflections on the marble floor
